# Kanbanize

Kanbanize is designed to help advanced product teams apply the principles of Lean and Kanban to their work to maximize results.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/kanbanize/.

## Actions

- **Add a comment to a card**: Add a comment to a Kanbanize card.
- **Check Board Milestone** (read-only): Check if a milestone is available on the specified board.
- **Delete Workflow**: Delete a workflow for the specified board.
- **Get Columns** (read-only): Get a list of columns for a specific board in Kanbanize.
- **Get Custom Fields** (read-only): Retrieve a list of custom fields from Kanbanize with optional filtering.
- **Check User Is Card Watcher** (read-only): Check if a user is a watcher of a specific card.
- **Delete Board**: Delete a board by its ID.
- **Delete Card**: Delete a card from the Kanbanize board.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete a tag from Kanbanize.
- **Get Board Block Reasons** (read-only): Get a list of block reasons available on a board.
- **Get Board Card Templates** (read-only): Retrieve a list of card templates available on a Kanbanize board.
- **Get Child Cards** (read-only): Retrieve a list of child cards for a specified parent card.
- **Get Column** (read-only): Get the details of a specific column from a Kanbanize board.
- **Get Stickers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of stickers with optional filtering by sticker IDs, label, availability, and enabled status.
- **Get User** (read-only): Get the details of a specified user in Kanbanize.
- **Get workflow cycle time columns** (read-only): Retrieve workflow's cycle time columns from a Kanbanize board.
- **Get Workspace Data Fields** (read-only): Retrieve a list of data fields available on a workspace.
- **Remove Board Block Reason**: Make a block reason unavailable on a board.
- **Remove Child Card**: Remove the link between a parent card and a child card.
- **Set card block reason**: Block a Kanbanize card by setting a block reason.
- **Update Board Sticker**: Update the properties of a sticker for the specified board.
- **Update Data Field Workspaces**: Add, update, or remove a data field on one or more workspaces via batch operations.
- **Update Lane Default Setting**: Update the default value of a specific lane setting in Kanbanize.
- **Update Tag**: Update the specified tag in Kanbanize.
